name: SuperDuperBundle Game Price API
description: Look up a game by name, Steam app ID or store URL and get the lowest listed price in US dollars, the store, when it was checked, and the compare page on SuperDuperBundle. Free, no key. Show the attribution and link every price to the game's `url`. Terms: https://superduperbundle.com/tools/api/#terms
